To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) design thinking and the lean startup approach are complementary and (2) this complementarity is based on their specific benefits in the front end and back end of the innovation processes, respectively.
design thinking and lean startups should be pursued simultaneously in a complementary manner to achieve the full benefits of agile innovation.
design thinking and lean start-up complement each other and should be pursued simultaneously in order to fully leverage the respective benefits.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how design thinking and lean start-up can be combined in a synergetic way.
the question of how to combine design thinking and lean start-up in order to achieve agile innovation.
a novel approach to innovation that combines design thinking and lean startups.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
agile innovation is a process that is characterized by design thinking in the early stages and by the lean startup approach in the later stages.
the combination of design thinking and the lean startup approach enables firms to achieve a more agile innovation process, which, in turn, can lead to higher innovation performance.
the design thinking–lean startup combination is superior to both design thinking and lean start-up in isolation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
design thinking is the better way to start and lean startup the better way to finish an innovation project.
design thinking is a powerful tool to generate and refine innovative ideas, whereas lean startup is the best way to test and refine the business model of an innovation project.
executives can increase the success probability of their innovation efforts by simultaneously pursuing design thinking and lean start-up initiatives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
companies should combine design thinking and lean startups to fully leverage the agility of innovation processes.
executives should not only focus on one or the other approach, but rather on both approaches simultaneously.
design thinking and lean start-up are not substitutes, but rather complementary approaches.
